page-layout: full

```{=html}
<style>
  #tp-wrap { --accent:#2e74b5; --head:#2e74b5; --sect:#bdd6ee; --box:#eef4fb; --boxline:#bdd6ee; --line:#272727;
    font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; color:#111; max-width:1000px; margin:0 auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-top img { width:min(300px,60%); height:auto; display:block; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:22px; line-height:1.25; margin:.7rem 0 .2rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; margin:.4rem 0 .8rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; width:100%; font-weight:bold; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { flex:0 1 50%; min-width:0; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:normal; padding:.35rem .5rem;
    border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); background:var(--box); border-radius:3px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap table { border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.3; }
  #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap td { border:1px solid var(--line); padding:3px 6px; vertical-align:middle; }
  #tp-wrap th { background:var(--head); color:#fff; font-weight:bold; text-align:left; }
  #tp-wrap th.c { text-align:center; }
  #tp-wrap tr.sec td { background:var(--sect); font-weight:bold; padding:1px 6px; }
  #tp-wrap td.topic { width:15%; vertical-align:top; }
  #tp-wrap td.item { width:6%; text-align:center; vertical-align:top; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg { width:11%; padding:3px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); border-radius:3px; background:var(--box);
    text-align:center; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; padding:6px 2px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:hover { border-color:var(--accent); }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:#6b86a6; font-size:12px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:block; font-weight:normal; font-size:11px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-cite { margin-top:1rem; font-size:14px; }
  .tp-actions { display:flex; gap:.6rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:1rem 0 1.4rem; }
  .tp-actions button { font:600 15px Arial,sans-serif; padding:.55rem 1.1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;
    border:2px solid #2e74b5; background:#2e74b5; color:#fff; }
  .tp-actions button.alt { background:#fff; color:#2e74b5; }
  .tp-actions button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f3b800; outline-offset:2px; }
  .tp-note { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; color:#444; margin:0; flex-basis:100%; }

  @media print {
    @page { size:A4 portrait; margin:12mm; }
    body * { visibility:hidden; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap * { visibility:visible; }
    #tp-wrap { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; max-width:none; }
    .tp-actions { display:none !important; }
    #tp-wrap table { font-size:9.5px; }
    #tp-wrap tr { break-inside:avoid; }
    #tp-wrap thead { display:table-header-group; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:17px; }
    #tp-wrap td.pg input { background:none; border:0; }
    #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:transparent; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:none; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-cite { font-size:10.5px; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap tr.sec td { -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact; print-color-adjust:exact; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { border:0; padding:0; background:none; flex:1 1 auto; }
  }
</style>

<div id="tp-wrap">
  <div class="tp-top"><img src="tripod-logo.png" alt="TRIPOD" id="tp-logo"></div>
  <div class="tp-title">TRIPOD-Cluster checklist for reporting prediction models developed or validated using clustered data</div>
  <div class="tp-actions">
    <button type="button" id="tp-pdf">Save as PDF</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-doc" class="alt">Save as Word</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-reset" class="alt">Clear all</button>
    <p class="tp-note">Type the page number(s) where each item is reported in the blue boxes in the right-hand column, then save your copy as a PDF or Word (.docx) file.
    “Save as PDF” opens your browser’s print dialog: choose <em>Save as PDF</em> as the destination.
    Your entries stay in this browser until you clear them.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-meta"><label>Manuscript title: <input type="text" id="tp-title" data-key="title" placeholder="Type your manuscript title here"></label></div>
  <table id="tp-table">
    <thead><tr>
      <th>Section and topic</th><th class="c">Item No.</th><th>Checklist item</th>
      <th class="c">Page<span class="tp-hint">type page no. in the boxes below</span></th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody></tbody>
  </table>
  <p class="tp-cite">From: Debray TPA, Collins GS, Riley RD, et al. <em>BMJ</em> 2023;380:e071018. <a href="https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2022-071018" target="_blank" rel="noopener">doi:10.1136/bmj-2022-071018</a></p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // ["Topic", "item", "text"]; topic "" = continuation row; plain strings = section bars
  const ROWS = [
    "Title and Abstract",
    ["Title", "1", "Identify the study as developing and/or validating a multivariable prediction model, the target population, and the outcome to be predicted."],
    ["Abstract", "2", "Provide a summary of research objectives, setting, participants, data source, sample size, predictors, outcome, statistical analysis, results, and conclusions."],
    "Introduction",
    ["Background and objectives", "3a", "Explain the medical context (including whether diagnostic or prognostic) and rationale for developing or validating the prediction model, including references to existing models, and the advantages of the study design."],
    ["", "3b", "Specify the objectives, including whether the study describes the development or validation of the model."],
    "Methods",
    ["Participants and data", "4a", "Describe eligibility criteria for participants and datasets."],
    ["", "4b", "Describe the origin of the data, and how the data were identified, requested and collected."],
    ["Sample size", "5", "Explain how the sample size was arrived at."],
    ["Outcomes and predictors", "6a", "Define the outcome that is predicted by the model, including how and when assessed."],
    ["", "6b", "Define all predictors used in developing or validating the model, including how and when measured."],
    ["Data preparation", "7a", "Describe how the data were prepared for analysis, including any cleaning, harmonisation, linkage, and quality checks."],
    ["", "7b", "Describe the method for assessing risk of bias and applicability in the individual clusters (e.g., using PROBAST)."],
    ["", "7c", "For validation, identify any differences in definition and measurement from the development data (e.g., setting, eligibility criteria, outcome, predictors)."],
    ["", "7d", "Describe how missing data were handled."],
    ["Data analysis", "8a", "Describe how predictors were handled in the analyses."],
    ["", "8b", "Specify the type of model, all model-building procedures (e.g., any predictor selection and penalization), and method for validation."],
    ["", "8c", "Describe how any heterogeneity across clusters (e.g., studies or settings) in model parameter values was handled."],
    ["", "8d", "For validation, describe how the predictions were calculated."],
    ["", "8e", "Specify all measures used to assess model performance (e.g., calibration, discrimination, and decision curve analysis) and, if relevant, to compare multiple models."],
    ["", "8f", "Describe how any heterogeneity across clusters (e.g., studies or settings) in model performance was handled and quantified."],
    ["", "8g", "Describe any model updating (e.g., recalibration) arising from the validation, either overall or for particular populations or settings."],
    ["Sensitivity analysis", "9", "Describe any planned subgroup or sensitivity analysis, e.g., assessing performance according to sources of bias, participant characteristics, setting."],
    "Results",
    ["Participants and datasets", "10a", "Describe the number of clusters and participants from data identified through to data analysed. A flow chart may be helpful."],
    ["", "10b", "Report the characteristics overall and where applicable for each data source or setting, including the key dates, predictors, treatments received, sample size, number of outcome events, follow-up time, and amount of missing data."],
    ["", "10c", "For validation, show a comparison with the development data of the distribution of important variables (demographics, predictors, and outcome)."],
    ["Risk of bias", "11", "Report the results of the risk of bias assessment in the individual clusters."],
    ["Model development and specification", "12a", "Report the results of any across-cluster heterogeneity assessments that led to subsequent actions during the model’s development (e.g., inclusion or exclusion of particular predictors or clusters)."],
    ["", "12b", "Present the final prediction model (i.e., all regression coefficients, and model intercept or baseline estimate of the outcome at a given time point) and explain how to use it for predictions in new individuals."],
    ["Model performance", "13a", "Report performance measures (with uncertainty intervals) for the prediction model, overall and for each cluster."],
    ["", "13b", "Report results of any heterogeneity across clusters in model performance"],
    ["Model updating", "14", "Report the results from any model updating (including the updated model equation and subsequent performance), overall and for each cluster."],
    ["Sensitivity analysis", "15", "Report results from any subgroup or sensitivity analysis."],
    "Discussion",
    ["Interpretation", "16a", "Give an overall interpretation of the main results, including heterogeneity across clusters in model performance, in the context of the objectives and previous studies."],
    ["", "16b", "For validation, discuss the results with reference to the model performance in the development data, and in any previous validations."],
    ["", "16c", "Discuss the strengths of the study and any limitations (e.g., missing or incomplete data, non-representativeness, data harmonisation problems)"],
    ["Implications", "17", "Discuss the potential use of the model and implications for future research, with specific view to generalizability and applicability of the model across different settings or (sub)populations."],
    "Other information",
    ["Supplementary Information", "18", "Provide information about the availability of supplementary resources (e.g., study protocol, analysis code, data sets)."],
    ["Funding", "19", "Give the source of funding and the role of the funders for the present study."]
  ];
  const TITLE = "TRIPOD-Cluster checklist for reporting prediction models developed or validated using clustered data";

  const STORE = "tripod-cluster-checklist-v1";
  const tbody = document.querySelector("#tp-table tbody");
  const linkify = t => t.replace(/\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g, (_, label, url) => {
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.setAttribute("target", "_blank"); a.setAttribute("rel", "noopener");
    a.setAttribute("data-url", url); a.textContent = label;
    return a.outerHTML;
  });
  tbody.innerHTML = ROWS.map(r => typeof r === "string"
    ? `<tr class="sec"><td colspan="4">${r}</td></tr>`
    : `<tr><td class="topic">${r[0]}</td><td class="item">${r[1]}</td><td class="txt">${linkify(r[2])}</td>` +
      `<td class="pg"><input type="text" data-key="p${r[1]}" placeholder="page no." aria-label="Page, item ${r[1]}"></td></tr>`).join("");
  tbody.querySelectorAll("a[data-url]").forEach(a => { a.href = a.getAttribute("data-url"); a.removeAttribute("data-url"); });

  const fields = () => [...document.querySelectorAll("#tp-wrap input")];
  const load = () => { try { const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || "{}");
    fields().forEach(i => { if (d[i.dataset.key]) i.value = d[i.dataset.key]; }); } catch (e) {} };
  const save = () => { try { const d = {}; fields().forEach(i => { if (i.value) d[i.dataset.key] = i.value; });
    localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(d)); } catch (e) {} };
  load();
  document.getElementById("tp-wrap").addEventListener("input", save);

  // Save as PDF via the browser print dialog (print CSS shows only the checklist)
  document.getElementById("tp-pdf").onclick = () => {
    const old = document.title;
    document.title = "TRIPOD-Cluster checklist";
    window.print();
    document.title = old;
  };

  document.getElementById("tp-reset").onclick = () => {
    if (confirm("Clear all page numbers and the manuscript title?")) { fields().forEach(i => i.value = ""); save(); }
  };

  // ---- Word (.docx) export -------------------------------------------------
  // <BUILD>
  function buildDocx(D, ROWS, vals, logo, title) {
    const F = "Arial", SZ = 17, W = [1500, 700, 7066, 1200], TOTAL = W.reduce((a, b) => a + b);
    const line = { style: D.BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: "272727" };
    const borders = { top: line, bottom: line, left: line, right: line };
    const run = (text, o = {}) => new D.TextRun({ text, font: F, size: o.size || SZ, bold: o.bold, color: o.color });
    const runs = (text, o = {}) => {
      const out = [], re = /\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g; let last = 0, m;
      while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
        if (m.index > last) out.push(run(text.slice(last, m.index), o));
        out.push(new D.ExternalHyperlink({ link: m[2], children: [new D.TextRun({ text: m[1], font: F, size: o.size || SZ, color: "0563C1", underline: {} })] }));
        last = re.lastIndex;
      }
      if (last < text.length) out.push(run(text.slice(last), o));
      return out;
    };
    const cell = (i, text, o = {}) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: o.span ? TOTAL : W[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnSpan: o.span,
      verticalAlign: o.top ? D.VerticalAlign.TOP : D.VerticalAlign.CENTER,
      shading: o.fill ? { type: D.ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: o.fill, color: "auto" } : undefined,
      margins: { top: 40, bottom: 40, left: 90, right: 90 }, borders,
      children: [new D.Paragraph({ alignment: o.center ? D.AlignmentType.CENTER : D.AlignmentType.LEFT, children: runs(text, o) })]
    });
    const hd = { fill: "2E74B5", bold: true, color: "FFFFFF" };
    const head = new D.TableRow({ tableHeader: true, cantSplit: true, children: [
      cell(0, "Section and topic", hd), cell(1, "Item No.", { ...hd, center: true }),
      cell(2, "Checklist item", hd), cell(3, "Page", { ...hd, center: true })] });
    const body = ROWS.map(r => typeof r === "string"
      ? new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [cell(0, r, { span: true, fill: "BDD6EE", bold: true })] })
      : new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [
          cell(0, r[0], { top: true }), cell(1, r[1], { center: true, top: true }), cell(2, r[2]),
          cell(3, vals["p" + r[1]] || "", { center: true })] }));
    const para = (children, o = {}) => new D.Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 80 }, ...o, children });
    const top = [];
    if (logo) top.push(para([new D.ImageRun({ data: logo, type: "png", transformation: { width: 240, height: Math.round(240 * 68 / 316) } })]));
    top.push(para([new D.TextRun({ text: title, font: F, size: 28 })], { spacing: { before: 60, after: 120 } }));
    top.push(para([run("Manuscript title: ", { bold: true, size: 20 }), run(vals.title || "", { size: 20 })], { spacing: { after: 120 } }));
    return new D.Document({
      title: "TRIPOD-Cluster checklist", creator: "TRIPOD-Cluster checklist",
      sections: [{
        properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 }, margin: { top: 720, bottom: 720, left: 720, right: 720 } } },
        children: [...top, new D.Table({ width: { size: TOTAL, type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: W, rows: [head, ...body] }),
          para(runs("From: Debray TPA, Collins GS, Riley RD, et al. BMJ 2023;380:e071018. [[doi:10.1136/bmj-2022-071018|https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2022-071018]]", { size: 16 }), { spacing: { before: 160 } })]
      }]
    });
  }
  // </BUILD>

  const loadDocx = () => window.docx ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const el = document.createElement("script");
    el.src = new URL("docx.min.js", document.baseURI).href;
    el.onload = res; el.onerror = () => rej(new Error("Could not load docx.min.js"));
    document.head.appendChild(el);
  });

  document.getElementById("tp-doc").onclick = async () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("tp-doc"), label = btn.textContent;
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Preparing…";
    try {
      await loadDocx();
      let logo = null;
      try { logo = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(new URL("tripod-logo.png", document.baseURI))).arrayBuffer()); } catch (e) {}
      const vals = {}; fields().forEach(i => vals[i.dataset.key] = i.value);
      const blob = await window.docx.Packer.toBlob(buildDocx(window.docx, ROWS.map(r => typeof r === "string" ? r : [r[0], r[1], r[2].replace(/\|([^|\]]*)\]\]/, (_, u) => "|" + new URL(u, document.baseURI).href + "]]")]), vals, logo, TITLE));
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([blob], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" }));
      a.download = "TRIPOD-Cluster-checklist.docx";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Sorry, the Word file could not be created. " + e.message);
    } finally { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = label; }
  };
})();
</script>
```
